1.title: One Cat per Color
1.subtitle: Each colored area hides exactly one cat. Mark the rest with ×!
1.voice: Rule one: One cat per color. Every colored region hides exactly one cat. Mark the empty tiles with an X to narrow it down!

2.title: One per Row & Column
2.subtitle: No two cats can share the same horizontal row or vertical column.
2.voice: Rule two: One cat per row and column. No two cats can share the same horizontal row or vertical column.

3.title: Cats Never Touch
3.subtitle: Cats love space! Keep all 8 surrounding tiles clear — even diagonally.
3.voice: Rule three: Cats never touch. Keep all eight surrounding tiles clear around every cat, including diagonals!
